doubts: Q3 and Y7 quotes are from the supplement (supplement page 3). Q3: only a few P2P-specific values are given, the rest is 'the same with those in MBPO' without listing, so no. X7: the checklist points to Appendix B for compute, but Appendix B has none. Y3: six MuJoCo tasks in Figure 2 (InvertedDoublePendulum, Hopper, Walker2d, HalfCheetah, Ant, Humanoid); the maze tasks are an interpretative side experiment. Y6: the deliberate discarding of offline samples in the maze experiment is read as a stated data exclusion (deviation 19), borderline. Y7: MuJoCo tasks have no version suffix; only maze2d-large-v1 is versioned. Y9: planning horizon (presented as a key parameter) swept in Figure 5.
